Q: Good afternoon. This is a recorded statement regarding the sideswipe collision you reported. Do you understand
that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was driving in League City, Texas, on the main road heading toward the freeway. I was trying to move into the
right lane because I needed to make an exit.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you were changing lanes.
A: I checked my mirror and saw the lane looked clear, so I signaled and started to move over. Then I felt a bump on
my passenger side and heard scraping. The other car had been in my blind spot, and I didn't see it until we made
contact.
Q: Did you come to a stop after the impact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. I stayed in the car for a minute because my neck and lower back already felt stiff.
Q: Were you taken to a medical facility?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that day. They told me I had neck and back strain and gave me some
medication and instructions to rest.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, my neck is sore when I turn my head, and my lower back aches after sitting for long periods. I'm going to a
physical therapy appointment next week.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
